title: CARLAB Wheel End Provenance Vocabulary Mapping Specification
author: gemini-3-8-flash
description: Cross-workstream mapping reconciling R-08 quality gate tiers, C-01 CAD release source grades, and vehicle snapshot mapping statuses for downstream consumers.

DEMO_ASSUMPTION.context: C-01 CAD package, parameters, materials, and mounts
DEMO_ASSUMPTION.definition: Parametric CAD geometry and material definitions generated from engineering assumptions without certified OEM production drawings.
DEMO_ASSUMPTION.mathematicalIntegrity: VERIFIED (watertight, manifold solid, zero CAD self-intersection in C-01)
DEMO_ASSUMPTION.vehicleEngineeringRelease: UNVERIFIED (dimensions are demonstration estimates, not verified vehicle release)
DEMO_ASSUMPTION.consumerRule: Downstream viewers (Composer R-29) and consumers (DeepSeek R-32) must label instances as DEMO_ASSUMPTION. Prohibited from claiming verified OEM clearance.

DEMO_ESTIMATE.context: R-08 Asset Quality Gates (Level 4 Provenance Tier)
DEMO_ESTIMATE.definition: CAD models created for pipeline validation, visual simulation, or unit testing.
DEMO_ESTIMATE.consumerRule: Compatible with non-production preview pipelines. Fails closed under strict production gate unless explicitly handled in demo mode.

DEMO_SUBSTITUTE.definition: Physical CAD mesh substituted as a visual stand-in for a logical snapshot PartInstance (PI-*), without asserting same-vehicle verification.
DEMO_SUBSTITUTE.consumerRule: DeepSeek R-32 binds mesh to snapshot nodes using DEMO_SUBSTITUTE. Must retain sameVehicleClaim=false. Grok R-33 must NOT treat as dynamic kinematic closure.

NO_GEOMETRY.definition: Logical vehicle engineering node without any physical CAD mesh.
NO_GEOMETRY.consumerRule: Viewer must display as unmodeled/bounding wireframe node; never synthesize fake geometry without tagging.

COUNTERPART_NOT_MODELED.definition: Mounting interface whose mating component (e.g. control arm, tie rod) has not yet been modeled in CAD.
COUNTERPART_NOT_MODELED.consumerRule: Assembly solver must mark joint as UNCOUPLED; kinematics solver must block dynamic closure unless grounded by explicit fixture assumptions.

OEM_SPEC.context: R-08 Level 2 Provenance Tier / Certified Production CAD
OEM_SPEC.definition: Geometry directly derived from manufacturer engineering drawings released for a verified vehicle platform.
requirements: sourceId registered in offline provenance_registry.json with VERIFIED_VALID status
evidenceDocPath exists on disk in approved evidence repository
evidenceSha256 byte-level hash matches disk file exactly
authorized in registeredParts for the drawing
prohibits TEST_ONLY test fixtures in production mode

DeepSeek_R32.instruction: Bind C-01 9 mesh instances to PI-* using DEMO_SUBSTITUTE. Retain snapshotSha256 and variantId VAR-R16-BOF-ICE. Never elevate DEMO_SUBSTITUTE to OEM_VERIFIED.

Grok_R33.instruction: Knuckle local CAD mounts (bearingSeatFront, upper/lower ball joints) have DEMO_ASSUMPTION origins. Block kinematic closure if coordinate bases conflict. Do not invent fake outer tie-rod.

Composer_R29.instruction: Render C-01 meshes with visual badge [DEMO_ASSUMPTION]. Distinguish from NO_GEOMETRY nodes. Display provenance tooltip explaining unconfirmed OEM status.
